gate.verdict: TRUNK-SHARING CONFIRMED; our ens5 arms are identical to the reference in this respect, so 5.2's comparison is like with like and Phase 2 keeps its motivation

mechanism.statement: the five members share the feature extractor and the recurrent state; only the output heads differ, so member disagreement is head disagreement over identical features and cannot express uncertainty the trunk does not already carry
mechanism.status: candidate mechanism, established from source and parameter counts; whether it is THE explanation is tested by M-44 (Phase 2)
mechanism.symmetry_with_5_3: 5.3 shows the aleatoric head is trained by an objective whose optimum is sigma = 0. This shows the epistemic term is computed over an architecture whose members cannot disagree about anything the shared trunk does not already disagree with itself about. Both are structural, not incidental.

aux_trunk_constructed_once.note: the auxiliary pathway shares a trunk the same way

bounded_logstd_init.note: the PETS-lineage bounded log-sigma parameterisation (see 5.3 and the related work)

ensemble_size_is_five.note: the configured ensemble size for the released ANYmal D flat model

epistemic_is_head_spread.note: the epistemic term IS the spread of the heads over those identical features
epistemic_is_head_spread.text: epistemic_uncertainty = state_means.std(dim=0).sum(dim=1) if self.ensemble_size > 1 else torch.zeros(output_state_means.shape[0], device=self.device)

forward_heads_read_same_features.note: every head reads the identical feature vector -- the argument is loop-invariant

forward_shares_features.note: the trunk is evaluated ONCE per forward pass

head_is_two_small_mlps.note: each member's private part is a 256->128->45 mean tower plus a matching logstd tower

heads_replicated.note: the heads, and only the heads, are replicated ensemble_size times

heads_replication_count.note: the replication factor is ensemble_size; the trunk above it is not in the loop

mean_is_fed_back.note: with model_ids=None the ensemble MEAN is what leaves forward() and, in an autoregressive rollout, what is fed back into the single trunk

one_hidden_state.note: a single recurrent state, owned by the trunk, shared by every member

ours_epistemic.note: OUR epistemic term is the same head spread

ours_forward_shares.note: OUR forward evaluates the trunk once

ours_heads_read_same.note: OUR heads read the identical feature vector

ours_heads_replicated.note: OUR heads are the replicated part

ours_mean_fed_back.note: OUR rollout feeds the ensemble mean back into the single trunk, so the members share one hidden-state trajectory end to end

ours_trunk_once.note: OUR arms build one trunk the same way

penalty_consumes_epistemic.note: the head spread is the quantity the method penalises rewards with

trunk_constructed_once.note: ONE state trunk is built. Not a ModuleList, not indexed per member.

trunk_is_one_gru.note: the trunk is a single nn.GRU; Memory.hidden_states is one tensor for all members
trunk_is_one_gru.text: self.rnn = rnn_cls(input_size=self.input_dim, hidden_size=hidden_size, num_layers=num_layers, device=self.device, batch_first=True)

what_this_measures: which parameters are replicated across the 5 ensemble members and which are shared, established from upstream source, from the released checkpoint tensors, and from our own ensemble-5 arms
